question: (1)/(3) part of groceries sell at a profit of 18%, (1)/(4) part at a profit of 25% and remain sell at a profit of 30%. If the total profit is Rs 1980, find the desired price of groceries.
solution:
Given:

1/3 part sold at = 18% profit

1/4 part sold at = 25% profit

The remaining sell at a profit of 30%.

Total profit = 1980

Concept used:

Profit from each part = quantity × profit percentage

Calculation:

Let the total number of articles be 120.</p&
